2609.04415.title: REFINE: LLM Refinement over Budgeted Text-Attributed Graphs for Personalized Medical Concept Representation
2609.04415.paper_summary: Learning rich medical concept representations is essential for EHR prediction. Text-attributed knowledge graphs (TKGs) provide a natural foundation by organizing heterogeneous medical relations together with textual semantics. However, most existing encoders process concepts uniformly across patients, despite the fact that a code's meaning and predictive value depend on patient-specific clinical context and trajectory. Learning patient-personalized concept representations from TKGs introduces two key challenges: (1) deciding how much KG context to incorporate for each observed code, and (2) aligning semantic information with the patient-specific relational structure. We propose REFINE, a KG-aware budgeted LLM graph refinement framework for patient-personalized medical concept encoding. Starting from a global TKG, REFINE constructs patient-specific temporal graphs. A sequential reinforcement learning policy selects a personalized KG expansion budget for each observed code. The resulting patient graph is processed by a heterogeneous GNN to capture relation-aware structural dependencies, while a frozen LLM uses graph-aware soft prompts to semantically refine concept representations. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that REFINE consistently improves diverse EHR backbones, outperforms strong baselines, and demonstrates robust gains across component ablation, KG selection, and data insufficiency.
2609.04415.paper_summary_zh: 學習豐富的醫療概念表示對於電子健康紀錄（EHR）預測至關重要。文本屬性知識圖（TKGs）通過組織異質醫療關係和文本語義，提供了一個自然的基礎。然而，大多數現有的編碼器在處理概念時對所有患者採取統一方式，儘管一個代碼的含義和預測價值依賴於患者特定的臨床背景和發展軌跡。從TKGs中學習患者個性化的概念表示引入了兩個關鍵挑戰：（1）決定對每個觀察到的代碼納入多少KG上下文，以及（2）將語義信息與患者特定的關係結構對齊。我們提出了REFINE，一個KG感知的預算化LLM圖形精煉框架，用於患者個性化的醫療概念編碼。REFINE從一個全局TKG開始，構建患者特定的時間圖。順序強化學習策略為每個觀察到的代碼選擇個性化的KG擴展預算。生成的患者圖由異質GNN處理，以捕捉關係感知的結構依賴性，而一個凍結的LLM則使用圖感知的軟提示來語義上精煉概念表示。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上的實驗顯示，REFINE始終改善多樣的EHR骨幹，超越強基準，並在組件消融、KG選擇和數據不足方面展示了穩健的增益。
